ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips; estimated 98:2 ratio of dark to light pixels on the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark low-intensity field across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are restricted to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations along the entire trailing edge; serrations are more pronounced and jagged toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations (barnacle clusters) covering the peripheral edges of the distal tips; slight irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
